summary: Ice climber fell from the Fang, an East Vail ice climb, and was seriously injured; partner called for help at 8:55 p.m.
notes: Vail Fire Department and Eagle County Paramedic Services also responded. From the Vail Chamber/Vail Daily (Edward Stoner) roundup of VMRG Jan-Mar 2015 missions; page opened 2026-09-13; excerpt truncated after responder list.
